entities.summary: D'Onta Foreman is an American professional football running back. He played college football for the Texas Longhorns and was selected by the Houston Texans in the third round of the 2017 NFL draft. Foreman has also played for the Tennessee Titans, Carolina Panthers, and Chicago Bears.
